```{r soils, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Soils Data
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
gdb_path   <- "I:/Cogongrass_Project/data/Soils/gSSURGO_CONUS.gdb"
out_dir    <- "I:/Cogongrass_Project/data/Soils/taxorder_tiles"
out_final  <- "I:/Cogongrass_Project/data/Soils/taxorder_CONUS_30m.tif"
n_tiles_x  <- 10
n_tiles_y  <- 10

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Lookup Table
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("Building lookup...\n")
dc   <- st_read(gdb_path, layer = "DominantComponent", quiet = TRUE)
comp <- st_read(gdb_path, layer = "component", quiet = TRUE) |> select(cokey, taxorder)

lookup <- dc |>
  left_join(comp, by = "cokey") |>
  select(mukey, taxorder) |>
  mutate(
    mukey = as.integer(mukey),
    taxorder_int = case_when(
      taxorder == "Alfisols"    ~ 1L,
      taxorder == "Andisols"    ~ 2L,
      taxorder == "Aridisols"   ~ 3L,
      taxorder == "Entisols"    ~ 4L,
      taxorder == "Gelisols"    ~ 5L,
      taxorder == "Histosols"   ~ 6L,
      taxorder == "Inceptisols" ~ 7L,
      taxorder == "Mollisols"   ~ 8L,
      taxorder == "Spodosols"   ~ 9L,
      taxorder == "Ultisols"    ~ 10L,
      taxorder == "Vertisols"   ~ 11L,
      TRUE                      ~ NA_integer_
    )
  )
rm(dc, comp); gc()
cat("Lookup built:", nrow(lookup), "mukeys\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Raster Dimensions
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
r_tmp      <- rast(gdb_path)
total_nrow <- nrow(r_tmp)
total_ncol <- ncol(r_tmp)
r_ext      <- as.vector(ext(r_tmp))   # xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax
r_res      <- res(r_tmp)
r_crs      <- crs(r_tmp)
rm(r_tmp); gc()

tile_nrow  <- ceiling(total_nrow / n_tiles_y)
tile_ncol  <- ceiling(total_ncol / n_tiles_x)
cat(sprintf("Raster: %d x %d | Tile size: %d x %d\n",
            total_nrow, total_ncol, tile_nrow, tile_ncol))

dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Process tile function
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
process_tile <- function(tile_ix, tile_iy, gdb_path, lookup, out_dir,
                         tile_nrow, tile_ncol, total_nrow, total_ncol,
                         r_ext, r_res, r_crs) {

  tile_id  <- sprintf("tile_%02d_%02d", tile_iy, tile_ix)
  out_tile <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(tile_id, ".tif"))

  if (file.exists(out_tile)) {
    cat(sprintf("  [%s] Already exists, skipping.\n", tile_id))
    return(out_tile)
  }

  # Row/col bounds
  row_start <- (tile_iy - 1) * tile_nrow + 1
  col_start <- (tile_ix - 1) * tile_ncol + 1
  row_end   <- min(row_start + tile_nrow - 1, total_nrow)
  col_end   <- min(col_start + tile_ncol - 1, total_ncol)

  cat(sprintf("  [%s] rows %d-%d, cols %d-%d...\n",
              tile_id, row_start, row_end, col_start, col_end))

  # Convert row/col to spatial extent
  xmin_tile <- r_ext[1] + (col_start - 1) * r_res[1]
  xmax_tile <- r_ext[1] +  col_end        * r_res[1]
  ymax_tile <- r_ext[4] - (row_start - 1) * r_res[2]
  ymin_tile <- r_ext[4] -  row_end        * r_res[2]

  tile_ext <- ext(xmin_tile, xmax_tile, ymin_tile, ymax_tile)

  r_src  <- rast(gdb_path)
  tile_r <- crop(r_src, tile_ext)
  rm(r_src)

  # Extract mukey values
  mukey_vals <- values(tile_r, dataframe = FALSE, mat = FALSE)
  if (is.character(mukey_vals)) mukey_vals <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(mukey_vals))

  # Reclassify
  taxorder_int <- lookup$taxorder_int[match(mukey_vals, lookup$mukey)]

  # Build output raster
  tile_out <- rast(nrows = nrow(tile_r), ncols = ncol(tile_r),
                   ext = ext(tile_r), crs = r_crs)
  values(tile_out) <- taxorder_int

  writeRaster(tile_out, filename = out_tile, datatype = "INT1U",
              gdal = c("COMPRESS=DEFLATE", "PREDICTOR=2", "TILED=YES",
                       "BLOCKXSIZE=512", "BLOCKYSIZE=512"),
              overwrite = TRUE, NAflag = 255L)

  rm(tile_r, tile_out, mukey_vals, taxorder_int); gc()
  return(out_tile)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tile Loop
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n=== STARTING TILE PROCESSING ===\n")
t_start    <- proc.time()
tile_files <- character(n_tiles_x * n_tiles_y)
k <- 1

for (iy in 1:n_tiles_y) {
  for (ix in 1:n_tiles_x) {
    cat(sprintf("\nTile [%d/%d] (row-tile %d, col-tile %d)\n",
                k, n_tiles_x * n_tiles_y, iy, ix))
    tile_files[k] <- process_tile(
      tile_ix    = ix,   tile_iy    = iy,
      gdb_path   = gdb_path,        lookup     = lookup,
      out_dir    = out_dir,         tile_nrow  = tile_nrow,
      tile_ncol  = tile_ncol,       total_nrow = total_nrow,
      total_ncol = total_ncol,      r_ext      = r_ext,
      r_res      = r_res,           r_crs      = r_crs
    )
    k <- k + 1
    if (k %% 10 == 0) {
      elapsed <- (proc.time() - t_start)["elapsed"]
      cat(sprintf("  --> %d/%d done | %.1f min elapsed | ~%.1f min remaining\n",
                  k - 1, n_tiles_x * n_tiles_y, elapsed / 60,
                  (elapsed / (k - 1)) * (n_tiles_x * n_tiles_y - k + 1) / 60))
    }
  }
}
cat(sprintf("\nAll tiles done in %.1f min.\n",
            (proc.time() - t_start)["elapsed"] / 60))
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Mosaic Via VRT
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\nBuilding VRT mosaic...\n")
vrt_path <- file.path(out_dir, "taxorder_mosaic.vrt")
vrt_r    <- vrt(tile_files, vrt_path, overwrite = TRUE)
cat("VRT built OK\n")

cat("\nWriting final GeoTIFF (may take 20-40 min)...\n")
writeRaster(
  vrt_r,
  filename  = out_final,
  datatype  = "INT1U",
  gdal      = c("COMPRESS=DEFLATE", "PREDICTOR=2", "TILED=YES",
                "BLOCKXSIZE=512", "BLOCKYSIZE=512", "BIGTIFF=YES"),
  overwrite = TRUE,
  NAflag    = 255L
)
cat("Final raster written to:", out_final, "\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Verify Output & Print
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
order_levels <- c("Alfisols","Andisols","Aridisols","Entisols","Gelisols",
                  "Histosols","Inceptisols","Mollisols","Spodosols","Ultisols","Vertisols")

cat("\n=== VERIFICATION ===\n")
r_out <- rast(out_final)
print(r_out)

cat("\nCell counts by taxonomic order:\n")
freq_tbl <- freq(r_out)
freq_tbl$taxorder <- order_levels[match(freq_tbl$value, 1:11)]
freq_tbl$area_km2 <- round(freq_tbl$count * 30 * 30 / 1e6, 1)
print(freq_tbl[, c("value", "taxorder", "count", "area_km2")])

# Load the raster
r_out <- rast("I:/Cogongrass_Project/data/Soils/taxorder_CONUS_30m.tif")

# Define labels and colors
order_levels <- c("Alfisols","Andisols","Aridisols","Entisols","Gelisols",
                  "Histosols","Inceptisols","Mollisols","Spodosols","Ultisols","Vertisols")

order_colors <- c(
  "#E41A1C", "#377EB8", "#FF7F00", "#4DAF4A", "#984EA3",
  "#A65628", "#F781BF", "#FFFF33", "#1B9E77", "#D95F02", "#7570B3"
)

# Assign factor levels to raster
levels(r_out) <- data.frame(ID = 1:11, taxorder = order_levels)

# Plot
ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster(data = r_out) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values  = setNames(order_colors, order_levels),
    na.value = "white",
    name    = "Soil Order"
  ) +
  coord_sf() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "CONUS Soil Taxonomic Order (gSSURGO, 30m)")
```

## Align Rasters
```{r align-rasters}
# --- Check what CRS the rasters are in ---
cat("CRS of each raster:\n")
for (v in names(rast_list)) {
  cat(sprintf("  %-20s %s\n", v, crs(rast_list[[v]], describe = TRUE)$code))
}

# --- Use NDVI raster extent as the boundary ---
cat("\nExtracting extent from NDVI raster...\n")
ndvi_rast     <- rast(raster_paths[["ndvi"]])
ndvi_crs      <- crs(ndvi_rast)
ndvi_extent   <- ext(ndvi_rast)

cat(sprintf("NDVI CRS:    %s\n", crs(ndvi_rast, describe = TRUE)$code))
cat("NDVI Extent:\n")
print(ndvi_extent)

# --- Load, crop each raster to NDVI extent ---
local_dir <- "C:/local_cache"
dir.create(local_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

rast_list <- lapply(names(raster_paths), function(v) {
  src_path   <- raster_paths[[v]]
  local_path <- file.path(local_dir, paste0(v, ".tif"))

  if (!file.exists(local_path)) {
    cat(sprintf("  Copying %-20s to local cache...\n", v))
    r_src <- rast(src_path)
    writeRaster(r_src, local_path, overwrite = TRUE)
  }

  r <- rast(local_path)

  # Reproject the NDVI extent into this raster's CRS for cropping
  if (!same.crs(r, ndvi_rast)) {
    ndvi_ext_reproj <- ext(project(vect(ndvi_extent, crs = ndvi_crs), crs(r)))
  } else {
    ndvi_ext_reproj <- ndvi_extent
  }

  r_crop <- crop(r, ndvi_ext_reproj)

  cat(sprintf("  %-20s done | dims: %d x %d | CRS: %s\n",
              v, nrow(r_crop), ncol(r_crop),
              crs(r_crop, describe = TRUE)$code))
  r_crop
})
names(rast_list) <- names(raster_paths)

```

## Env Stack for Prediction
I will change ref_rast to pr for now, to make predictions at the 4km scale. I can switch back to ndvi if we decide 30 m resolution is needed. Because weather data is at 4km, weather pixels become roughly 17,000 identical pixels.

```{r env-stack}
# Use the NDVI raster as the reference grid for alignment
ref_rast <- rast_list[["ndvi"]] 

cat("Aligning all rasters to the NDVI 30m reference grid...\n")
cat("\nReprojecting and resampling TreeCanopy and SoilType to match ref grid...\n")

rast_aligned <- lapply(names(rast_list), function(v) {
  r <- rast_list[[v]]
  
  # Define categorical layers that must use Nearest Neighbor
  categorical_layers <- c("SoilType", "nlcd")
  method <- if (v %in% categorical_layers) "near" else "bilinear"
  
  if (!same.crs(r, ref_rast)) {
    cat(sprintf("  Reprojecting: %s to 30m...\n", v))
    r <- project(r, ref_rast, method = method)
  } else if (!compareGeom(r, ref_rast, stopOnError = FALSE)) {
    cat(sprintf("  Resampling:   %s to 30m...\n", v))
    r <- resample(r, ref_rast, method = method)
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("  Already Aligned: %s\n", v))
  }
  r
})

names(rast_aligned) <- names(rast_list)

env_stack <- rast(rast_aligned)
names(env_stack) <- names(rast_aligned)
cat(sprintf("\nenv_stack: %d layers, %d x %d cells\n",
            nlyr(env_stack), nrow(env_stack), ncol(env_stack)))

# Check for NaN/NA in each layer
cat("\nNon-NA cell counts per layer:\n")
for (v in names(env_stack)) {
  n <- global(env_stack[[v]], fun = "notNA")[1,1]
  cat(sprintf("  %-20s %d\n", v, n))
}
```

## NLCD Masking
Only focus on forest, shrubland, or herbaceous areas
NLCD Classes: 41, 42, 43 (Forests); 52 (Shrub); 71 (Herbaceous); 90 (Woody Wetland); 95 (Emergent Wetland)
```{r nlcd-mask}
mask_habitats <- function(env_stack, nlcd_raster) {
  cat("Masking landscape to Forest, Shrubland, and Herbaceous cover...\n")
  
  # Align NLCD to the stack
  if(!compareGeom(nlcd_raster, env_stack, stopOnError = FALSE)) {
    nlcd_raster <- project(nlcd_raster, env_stack, method = "near")
  }
  
  # Define target classes
  target_classes <- c(41, 42, 43, 52, 71, 90, 95)
  mask_layer <- nlcd_raster %in% target_classes
  mask_layer[mask_layer == 0] <- NA
  
  # Apply mask to the entire stack
  env_stack_masked <- mask(env_stack, mask_layer)
  return(env_stack_masked)
}

env_stack <- mask_habitats(env_stack, rast_list[["nlcd"]])
```


## Predict Function
```{r predict-function}
# Takes a cogongrass cover value, builds predictor dataframe,
# sets MEMs to 0, predicts, returns a raster (If you use MEMs)

predict_diversity <- function(cogongrass_value, env_stack, rf_model, mem_vars) {
  cat(sprintf("  Predicting at Cogongrass_Cover = %d%%...\n", cogongrass_value))

  # Convert stack to data frame
  pred_df <- as.data.frame(env_stack, xy = FALSE, na.rm = FALSE)
  
  # Only predict for cells that aren't NA (masked out by NLCD or missing data)
  valid_cells <- complete.cases(pred_df)
  
  if(sum(valid_cells) == 0) stop("No valid cells found for prediction. Check NLCD mask.")

  # Build scenario data
  pred_df$Cogongrass_Cover <- cogongrass_value
  for (mem in mem_vars) pred_df[[mem]] <- 0 # MEMs held constant at 0

  all_vars <- attr(rf_model$terms, "term.labels")
  pred_df_valid <- pred_df[valid_cells, all_vars, drop = FALSE]

  # Generate predictions
  predicted_vals <- predict(rf_model, newdata = pred_df_valid)

  # Map values back to raster space
  predicted_full <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(pred_df))
  predicted_full[valid_cells] <- predicted_vals

  result_rast <- env_stack[[1]]
  values(result_rast) <- predicted_full
  names(result_rast) <- paste0("Shannon_", cogongrass_value)
  
  return(result_rast)
}
```

## Run Cogongrass Scenarios
```{r run-scenarios}
scenario_levels <- seq(0, 100, by = 1)
prediction_list <- list()

cat("\n========== Running All Cogongrass Scenarios ==========\n")
for(level in scenario_levels) {
  prediction_list[[paste0("p", level)]] <- predict_diversity(level, env_stack, rf_final, mem_vars)
}

baseline <- prediction_list[["p0"]]
diff_list <- list()

cat("\nCalculating differences relative to 0% baseline...\n")
for(level in scenario_levels[-1]) { # Skip 0
  diff_name <- paste0("Diff_", level, "_vs_0")
  diff_list[[diff_name]] <- prediction_list[[paste0("p", level)]] - baseline
  
  # Save result
  writeRaster(diff_list[[diff_name]], paste0(diff_name, ".tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
}
```

## Plot
```{r Visual}
plot_raster <- function(rast_layer, title = NULL, subtitle = NULL,
                        palette = "viridis", midpoint = NULL,
                        low = NULL, high = NULL, mid = NULL,
                        limits = NULL) {
  
  df <- as.data.frame(rast_layer, xy = TRUE)
  colnames(df)[3] <- "value"
  df <- df[!is.na(df$value), ]
  
  x_range <- range(df$x, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_range <- range(df$y, na.rm = TRUE)
  buf <- 0.5
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_raster(data = df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = value)) +
    geom_sf(data = states_sf, fill = NA, colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.3) +
    coord_sf(
      xlim = c(x_range[1] - buf, x_range[2] + buf),
      ylim = c(y_range[1] - buf, y_range[2] + buf)
    ) +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "right",
          axis.text = element_text(size = 8))
  
  if (!is.null(midpoint)) {
    p <- p + scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = low, mid = mid, high = high,
      midpoint = midpoint,
      limits = limits,
      name = "ΔShannon",
      na.value = "transparent"
    )
  } else {
    p <- p + scale_fill_viridis_c(
      option = palette,
      limits = limits,
      name = "Shannon\nDiversity",
      na.value = "transparent"
    )
  }
  
  return(p)
}

se_states <- c("Florida", "Georgia", "Alabama", "Mississippi", "South Carolina",
               "North Carolina", "Tennessee", "Arkansas", "Louisiana", "Virginia")

states_sf <- maps::map("state", fill = TRUE, plot = FALSE) %>%
             st_as_sf()

p_final <- plot_raster(diff_list[["Diff_100_vs_0"]],
                       midpoint = 0,
                       low = "#d73027", mid = "white", high = "#1a9850")

# To see it:
print(p_final)

ggsave("cogongrass_cover_100pct.png", p_final, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

## Patchwork
```{r patchwork}
# Shared color limit
all_vals <- unlist(lapply(seq(10, 100, by = 10), function(pct) {
  key <- paste0("Diff_", pct, "_vs_0")
  if (!is.null(diff_list[[key]])) {
    vals <- values(diff_list[[key]], na.rm = TRUE)
    return(vals)
  }
}))
max_abs <- max(abs(all_vals), na.rm = TRUE)
shared_limits <- c(-max_abs, max_abs)

cover_pcts <- seq(10, 100, by = 10)

plots <- lapply(cover_pcts, function(pct) {
  key <- paste0("Diff_", pct, "_vs_0")
  
  plot_raster(
    diff_list[[key]],
    title  = paste0(pct, "%"),
    midpoint = 0,
    low    = "#d73027", mid = "white", high = "#1a9850",
    limits = shared_limits
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text  = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    legend.position = if (pct == 100) "right" else "none"
  )
})


p_patch <- wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 5) +
  plot_annotation(
    title   = "Predicted Biodiversity Impact by Cogongrass Cover",
    subtitle = "ΔShannon relative to 0% baseline"
  )

print(p_patch)

ggsave("cogongrass_cover_patchwork.png", p_patch,
       width = 20, height = 9, dpi = 300)
```

```{r additional-analysis}
# Regional Summaries
states_vect <- terra::vect(states_sf)

regional_summary <- lapply(names(diff_list), function(nm) {
  
  r <- diff_list[[nm]]
  
  vals <- terra::extract(r, states_vect, fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  vals$State <- states_sf$ID[vals$ID]
  
  vals$Scenario <- nm
  vals
  
}) %>% bind_rows()


regional_summary$Scenario_num <- as.numeric(gsub("Diff_|_vs_0", "", regional_summary$Scenario))

regional_summary$Scenario_num <- as.numeric(gsub("Diff_|_vs_0", "", regional_summary$Scenario))

regional_long <- regional_summary %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Shannon_"),
    names_to = "Replicate",
    values_to = "Mean_Change"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Mean_Change))

print(regional_long)

ggplot(regional_long, aes(x = Scenario_num, y = Mean_Change, color = State)) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Cogongrass Cover (%)",
       y = "Δ Shannon Diversity",
       color = "State")

## Subset regional_long for 100% scenario
regional_100 <- regional_long %>%
  filter(Scenario_num == 100)

```

## EPA Ecoregions
```{r ecoregions}

eco_l2 <- st_read("NA_CEC_Eco_Level2.shp") %>% st_transform(crs(diff_list[[1]]))
eco_l3 <- st_read("NA_CEC_Eco_Level3.shp") %>% st_transform(crs(diff_list[[1]]))

eco_l2_vect <- terra::vect(eco_l2)
eco_l3_vect <- terra::vect(eco_l3)

summarize_by_ecoregion <- function(diff_list, eco_vect, name_col) {
  
  template_raster <- diff_list[[1]]
  
  eco_rast <- terra::rasterize(eco_vect, template_raster, field = name_col)
  
  lapply(names(diff_list), function(nm) {
    
    r <- diff_list[[nm]]
    
    z <- terra::zonal(r, eco_rast, fun = "mean", na.rm = TRUE)
    
    colnames(z) <- c("Ecoregion", "Mean_Change")
    z$Scenario <- nm
    
    z
    
  }) %>%
    bind_rows() %>%
    filter(!is.na(Mean_Change)) %>%
    mutate(
      Scenario_num = as.numeric(gsub("Diff_|_vs_0", "", Scenario))
    )
}


eco_l2_summary <- summarize_by_ecoregion(diff_list, eco_l2_vect, name_col = "NA_L2NAME")
eco_l3_summary <- summarize_by_ecoregion(diff_list, eco_l3_vect, name_col = "NA_L3NAME")

plot_eco_response <- function(summary_df, ecoregion_col = "Ecoregion",
                               title = NULL, ncol_legend = 1) {
  ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = Scenario_num, y = Mean_Change,
                          color = .data[[ecoregion_col]])) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(10, 100, 10)) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    labs(
      title   = title,
      x       = "Cogongrass Cover (%)",
      y       = "Δ Shannon Diversity",
      color   = NULL
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = ncol_legend))
}

p_l2 <- plot_eco_response(eco_l2_summary, title = "EPA Level 2 Ecoregions")
p_l3 <- plot_eco_response(eco_l3_summary, title = "EPA Level 3 Ecoregions", ncol_legend = 2)

print(p_l2)
print(p_l3)

plot_eco_100 <- function(summary_df, title = NULL) {
  summary_df %>%
    filter(Scenario_num == 100) %>%
    mutate(Ecoregion = reorder(Ecoregion, Mean_Change)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Mean_Change, y = Ecoregion, fill = Mean_Change)) +
      geom_col() +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
      scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#d73027", mid = "white", high = "#1a9850",
                           midpoint = 0, guide = "none") +
      theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
      labs(title = title, x = "Δ Shannon Diversity (100% cover)", y = NULL)
}

p_l2_100 <- plot_eco_100(eco_l2_summary, title = "EPA Level 2 — 100% Cogongrass")
p_l3_100 <- plot_eco_100(eco_l3_summary, title = "EPA Level 3 — 100% Cogongrass")

print(p_l2_100)
print(p_l3_100)


```

## US Ecoregion Extent- L2
```{r ecoregion-extent_L2}
eco_l2_100 <- eco_l2_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(Scenario_num == 100)

eco_l2_map <- eco_l2 %>%
  dplyr::left_join(eco_l2_100, by = c("NA_L2NAME" = "Ecoregion"))

eco_l2_map_vect <- terra::vect(eco_l2_map)

template_raster <- diff_list[[1]]

eco_l2_map_vect <- terra::crop(eco_l2_map_vect, template_raster)

terra::plot(
  eco_l2_map_vect,
  "Mean_Change",
  col = hcl.colors(50, "RdYlGn", rev = TRUE),
  main = "Δ Shannon Diversity (Level 2 Ecoregions, 100% Cogongrass)"
)

ggplot(eco_l2_map) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = Mean_Change), color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#d73027",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#1a9850",
    midpoint = 0
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Δ Shannon Diversity (Level 2 Ecoregions, 100% Cogongrass)",
    fill = "Change"
  )
```
